subject: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions
messages:
From: Simon Berg <simon.berg@medsys.eu>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Costa <ana.costa@medsys.eu>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions

Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedSys is very interested in Redwood for our clinical transcription and search workloads. Before we can move to procurement we need to firm up a few security and processing commitments from your side: 

- EU-only processing: can you confirm that production model endpoints and associated logs can be region-locked to EU (no egress to non-EU regions)? We need a clear statement for our DPA.
- VPC requirement: we prefer a private VPC deployment (or dedicated pool) with customer-controlled networking and KMS integration. Is that available for pilot and production?
- SIG / CAIQ: we will send our SIG template (attached) — please confirm an expected turnaround and whether Redwood will complete the commercial SIG.
- SOC 2: we also require SOC 2 Type 2 evidence for the last 12 months (summary or attestation PDF is fine initially).
- Data retention & deletion: we need guarantees on retention of logs/KV cache and an API/process for deletion tied to our tenant.

We are trying to close our vendor review by July 15 — please advise on timeline and what you can provide in the next 72 hours.

Best,
Simon
Security Lead, MedSys Europe
attachments: SIG_Request_Template.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Simon Berg <simon.berg@medsys.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions

Hi Simon — thanks for the clear list. I’ll outline what we can provide and the proposed next steps so you have something to include in procurement.

Quick answers up front:
- EU-only processing: yes — our Private and Dedicated offerings support strict regional routing and can be configured so production ingress/egress and logs remain inside EU regions. We will provide a short statement for your DPA and mark it in the contract.
- VPC: available. We support Private (VPC + optional on-prem package) and Dedicated GPU pools. Both support customer KMS and network controls.
- SIG / CAIQ: please send the SIG (thanks for attaching). We will run it through our security team and return a completed copy within 2 business days for most sections; items needing vendor-specific artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 report) may take a bit longer.
- SOC 2: I attached a SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf with the high-level attestation and scope. We can share redacted artifacts under NDA if required.
- Data deletion & audit logs: we have an administrative deletion API and tenant retention settings; we will provide the retention policy and an action plan for deletion of KV caches and logs.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Today: Acknowledge receipt (this email) and attach SOC2 summary and a short regional processing statement (attached).
2) +2 business days: Completed SIG answers (Redwood security) and network diagram for Private deployment.
3) +5 business days: Security call with MedSys engineers to walk the architecture and discuss KMS/egress controls.
4) +10 business days: EU Private PoC environment provisioned for MedSys (if you sign the pilot order).

I’m looping in Marissa (Solutions) for the network design and Neha (Legal) for DPA/SCCs language. Marissa — can you draft a minimal network diagram and confirm KMS and peering options? Neha — can you confirm whether redacted SOC2 artifacts will be sufficient for procurement or whether we should prepare an NDA/supplemental attestation?

Simon — we’ll aim to get SIG answers back by 2028-06-23. If that schedule works, we should be on track for your July 15 procurement runway.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf; regional_processing_statement.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Simon Berg <simon.berg@medsys.eu>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions

Simon / Diego — quick technical note from the solutions side.

Options to satisfy "EU-only" + VPC:
- Private (recommended for MedSys): Private control plane in EU, customer VPC peering, optional on-prem connector. Data plane never egresses outside the EU region when configured; logs and KV cache are tenant-scoped and stored in region.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pool in EU region with isolated tenancy. Slightly faster to provision but less network isolation than Private if you need customer-managed VPC.

KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) with CMK rotation and HSM-backed keys in most cloud regions (Azure/AWS EU regions).

Network artifacts attached: network_arch_diagram.pdf (shows peering, subnets, control plane boundary). I can join a technical call Wed/Thu afternoon (CEST) — here are slots: Wed 06/23 15:00-16:00 CEST, Thu 06/24 10:00-11:00 CEST.

One callout: for production we recommend Private with KMS and strict routing policy — that maps closest to your ask. We’ll include a short runbook for deletion and retention settings.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: network_arch_diagram.pdf

From: Simon Berg <simon.berg@medsys.eu>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Costa <ana.costa@medsys.eu>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions

Thanks Diego / Marissa — that all sounds promising. I’m attaching our completed SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx for you to review (we left a few vendor-specific items blank for you to complete). A few follow-ups:

- Can you confirm SCCs + DPA fallback language if EU-only processing cannot be fully guaranteed? We will need to see contract language on that.
- For deletion: does Redwood provide tenant-scoped purge that cascades to KV caches and replicas? We need an SLA for deletion action (e.g., 48-72 hours) once requested.
- Audit logs: what retention options do you support and can logs be exported to our SIEM in EU?

We are trying to lock vendors by July 15 — if you can return the completed SIG and the SCCs/DPA draft this week that would help.

Simon
attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-23T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Europe region lockdown — SIG evidence & VPC deployment questions (internal)

Team — summary and next steps for DEAL-7832 (MedSys Europe):

1) Marissa: please review SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx and complete vendor sections by EOD 2028-06-23. Confirm whether the Private PoC can be provisioned by 2028-06-30 for EU region and share an updated network_arch_diagram.pdf showing KMS integration and retention controls. Also provide the API name/endpoint for tenant-scoped deletion so I can include it in the response.

2) Neha: draft DPA/SCCs fallback language and advise whether redacted SOC2 artifacts under NDA are sufficient for procurement. If we need an interim NDA to share full artifacts, please prepare a one-way NDA template and estimate time to execution.

3) Diego (me): I will send MedSys the completed SIG, SOC2 summary, regional processing statement, and proposed MAP once Marissa confirms the PoC date. I will also coordinate the technical call — propose Wed 06/23 15:00 CEST if available.

Keep replies short — procurement wants a consolidated package to review.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
